_source: Catalogue row of the construction register (docs/design/v5.3-c-register.md). capacity, per nation, in the stock's own unit = the nation's mean enrolment per school in its stock: France 605 (data/units/stock/FRA.json: 2 142 289 enrolled pupils over 3 541 lycees), Germany 141 (data/units/stock/DEU.json: 1 392 662 full-time upper-secondary pupils over 9 854 schools, the count including schools without upper years, so a small figure). STAND-IN numbers, none sourced: every figure marked below is the game's declared placeholder until the author's table of stand-ins (spec section 12). cost_eur_m: stand-in of 0.0575 M EUR per pupil, the middle of the press-release anchor of 52 to 69 M EUR for a lycee of 900 to 1 200 places (not verified); a bounded search for a Cour des comptes or regional council deliberation, the UK DfE National School Delivery Cost Benchmarking and a Landesrechnungshof report found no per-pupil figure. running_eur_m: stand-in of 9 000 EUR per pupil a year. staff: stand-in of 90 jobs. build_months, overrun_odds, overrun_share, demolish_months, demolish_cost_share, band_units: the spec's stand-ins (sections 5, 7, 12). figure_elasticity: -1 by the spec (more places, fewer pupils per teacher). bloc_offset_per_pop_share: stand-in. DEU: the same 0.0575 M EUR per pupil and 9 000 EUR per pupil a year as FRA applied to its 141-pupil unit (8.1 and 1.3 M EUR); a bounded search of the Landesrechnungshof reports found no German benchmark (the Sachsen 2019 report on a new Leipzig Gymnasium and a Niedersachsen table of investment per pupil were the leads, neither read as a raw cell).
name: Upper secondary school
summary: A lycee or Gymnasium: a school for the last years before university or a trade.
